definitions.explanation: A unit of measurement used in cooking, equal to 5 milliliters. Also refers to the small spoon itself used for measuring.

examples.japanese: {塩|しお}{小|こ}さじ1を{加|くわ}える。
{砂糖|さとう}を{小|こ}さじ2{杯|はい}{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put in two teaspoons of sugar.

examples.japanese: このレシピでは、しょうゆ{小|こ}さじ1と{酢|す}{小|こ}さじ2を{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせます。
examples.english: In this recipe, mix together one teaspoon of soy sauce and two teaspoons of vinegar.

notes:
{小|こ}さじ is a standard cooking measurement equal to 5 ml (one teaspoon). It is one of the two fundamental measuring spoon sizes in Japanese cooking.

MEASUREMENT PAIR:
- {小|こ}さじ: teaspoon (5 ml)
- {大|おお}さじ: tablespoon (15 ml) — three times a {小|こ}さじ

RECIPE NOTATION:
In recipes, the amount follows directly after the ingredient:
- {塩|しお}{小|こ}さじ1: one teaspoon of salt
- {砂糖|さとう}{小|こ}さじ2: two teaspoons of sugar

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {小|こ}さじ{半分|はんぶん}: half a teaspoon
- {小|こ}さじ{山盛|やまも}り: a heaped teaspoon
- {小|こ}さじ{摺|す}り{切|き}り: a level teaspoon

FORMS:
{小|こ} (small) + さじ (spoon). さじ is from the Portuguese word for spoon. The kanji form is {匙|さじ}.
